data.title: 芙兰达 · 卧室软床上的贝雷帽卸下温存

data.promptProse: Pinned gently back across rumpled sheets in a dimly lit bedroom at night, Frenda Seivelun wears a translucent pastel-pink ruffled lace babydoll nightgown pushed high over her thighs. Wrapping both arms around her partner's neck with a furious blush and breathless parted lips, she glows beneath a warm bedside lamp.
